name: Truth Scrapper
source:
Deep within a mysterious sinkhole known as The Dwell, people have been attacked, and have lost all sense of will. Members of the Truth Scrappers guild… just like you!

As the cute and silly Sosotte, you’ve been sent to investigate what happened to your fellow guildsfolk, which would be a big task even if your memories didn’t reset at the end of each day. 

Thanks to your very special magic book, however, you can choose a few things to remember every day.

Things you saw or experienced, maybe clues, or maybe even how you feel about the mischievous and curious Amour and the kind and proper Betz, two Path Dwellers who seem eager to guide you around the Dwell and its surrounding city.

But when memories are more precious than gold, can you REALLY afford to remember them both… Or will you have to choose one?

[From [url=https://truthscrapper.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
在一處名為「棲穴」的神秘天坑深處，有人遭到襲擊，徹底失去了自主意志。那是真相拾荒者公會的成員……和你一樣！

你將扮演可愛又有點傻乎乎的索索特，奉命調查公會同伴的遭遇。就算你的記憶不會在每一天結束時重置，這也絕不是件輕鬆的差事。

不過，多虧你那本極其特別的魔法書，每天你都可以挑選幾件事記下來。

可以記住你看到或經歷的事，可能是線索，也可能是你對淘氣好奇的阿穆爾和親切端正的貝茨的感情。這兩位徑道居民似乎都很樂意帶你四處看看，認識棲穴和環繞它的城市。

可當記憶比黃金還貴重時，你真的有餘裕把他們兩個都記住嗎……還是只能從中選一個？

［取自[url=https://truthscrapper.com/]官方網站[/url]］
